items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999

ctx.x: How many years did you put into the studio?

When I went into the studio I was doing a minimum of six half hours shows a week with Earle Hagen, Herbie Spencer, who, God bless, a wonderful guy, used to orchestrate for Kostelanetz years ago in New York, and in fact he was doing a lot for John Williams, that’s a whole different story I’ll bring in, I lived next to his folks, before he came into town, a great piano player John is really, more so than anything else. Sometime we’ll go into it. But at that time like I guess from Alfred Newman to Hugo Friedhofer to…
